title: Dead Rails
description: Makes Minecraft into the Roblox game 'Dead Rails' by changing various textures.
body:
Changes various textures in the game to mimic the items and mobs in the popular Roblox game called 'Dead Rails'.
This is not a complete texture pack and does not retexture every Minecraft texture, just ones that are featured with the same name in Dead Rails or unique items from Dead Rails that have been added to Minecraft.

Any suggestions for retextures can be given to my discord 'minorspellingmistake' and I will try to do them in a timely manner. **The single version that is listed should still work for any version.**

### Good luck survivors!
